summary: Changes required before source integration: static source and oracle verification against the public mori-core basis confirms all financial arithmetic, gross/fee/net conservation, linked invoice successor state, absent vs. present-zero liability semantics, preserved state/balances/duties, public API usage, and logical cost counts (42/42 and 45), but reveals a concrete canonical balance-ordering defect in the frozen multi-asset reserve oracle payloads. runtime::scenario_snapshot (basis/crates/mori-core/src/runtime.rs:631) sorts Snapshot.balances by (&a.asset, &a.account), placing reserve/BOND (index 2) before observer/CASH (index 3), whereas oracle/mori-tests.json, oracle/financial-and-work.json, and oracle/reserve-approved.scenario.json sort by (account, asset), placing observer/CASH at index 2 and reserve/BOND at index 3. This mismatch will cause the proposed reserve test's exact JSON Snapshot assertions on actual.pre, actual.post, and all 15 statement prefixes to fail.
findings: Defect (blocking source/oracle integration): Canonical multi-asset balance ordering mismatch between runtime.rs and frozen reserve oracle payloads. In basis/crates/mori-core/src/runtime.rs:631, scenario_snapshot sorts Snapshot.balances by (&a.asset, &a.account).cmp(&(&b.asset, &b.account)), where AssetId derives Ord in field order (network, issuer, reference, scale) (basis/crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:104-111). For conditional-reserve.mori, both assets share network="local" and issuer="financial-pair-reserve", and reference "BOND" < "CASH", so canonical Snapshot.balances places all BOND balances before all CASH balances: [auditor/BOND, observer/BOND, reserve/BOND, observer/CASH, reserve/CASH, supplier/CASH, treasury/CASH]. However, oracle/mori-tests.json (lines 77-85), oracle/financial-and-work.json (lines 103, 106, 108-122), and oracle/reserve-approved.scenario.json (lines 4-12) sort by (account, asset.reference), placing observer/CASH at index 2 and reserve/BOND at index 3. Because FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.rs (lines 120, 123, 140-143) asserts exact JSON array equality on actual.pre, actual.post, and every step.snapshot against expected["post"] and snapshot_from_columns(...), the reserve test approved_multiasset_reserve_matches_every_frozen_financial_prefix_and_total_work will fail at indices 2 and 3 of Snapshot.balances (and mori test on oracle/mori-tests.json case approved-reserve-multiasset will likewise fail poststate comparison). The frozen reserve expectations must be re-ordered to canonical (asset, account) order and re-frozen with updated FREEZE.sha256 digests before integration.

Financial arithmetic, conservation, and duty lifecycle: Verified by static source inspection across all 12 statements of installment-invoice.mori (two linked collect calls: first amount=47 atDay=30, final amount=80 atDay=60) and all 15 statements of conditional-reserve.mori (allocate with approved=true, amount=50, bondAmount=7). Per-asset balance sums are conserved at every prefix (CASH=258 in invoice; CASH=74 and BOND=29 in reserve). Gross/fee/net accounting matches (invoice first: payer -50, seller +47, treasury +3; invoice final: payer -83, seller +80, treasury +3; cumulative: gross 133, fees 6, net 127; reserve: CASH gross 52 = supplier 50 + treasury fee 2 leaving reserve 5 >= floor 5 after fee; BOND gross/net 7 leaving reserve 13).

Absence vs. present-zero and untouched state/duty preservation: Verified against runtime.rs (lines 433-444, 790-861). In installment-invoice, full discharge of invoice from 80 to 0 leaves a present-zero Liability entry in Snapshot.liabilities, while warranty=9, observer=23, reserve=19, and marker=77 remain untouched. In conditional-reserve, allocation starts absent (null in pre and prefixes 0..4), is accrued to 50 at statement 5, and is discharged to present-zero ("0") at statement 8, satisfying ensures liability_amount("allocation") == 0 at statement 13 while bond is partially discharged (10 -> 3) and emergency=2, observer balances (BOND=7, CASH=11), and marker=77 are preserved.

Aggregate and per-statement logical work schedule: Verified against basis/crates/mori-core/src/logical_cost.rs and runtime.rs (lines 395-431, 713). Under moriarty-reference-logical-cost/1 (1 unit per attempted statement + 1 unit per uncached ExprId node per statement, with per-statement cache reset and eager boolean operand evaluation), installment-invoice collect costs [4,4,6,2,2,2,2,4,4,4,6,2] = 42 units per call (84 across both calls; register = 4), and conditional-reserve allocate costs [5,4,4,6,4,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,4,2] = 45 units (register = 6). No statement in either program contains repeated subexpressions, so ExprId interning cannot alter node counts.

Public API typing, schema, and projection boundaries: FINANCIAL-PAIR-POSITIVE-TEST.rs imports only public root symbols from mori_core (Execution, Program, Scenario, UInt, parse, simulate, simulate_metered, validate), verifies scenario immutability, links the first invoice call's actual poststate (state, balances, liabilities) with final inputs to check equality against invoice-final.scenario.json before the second call, and checks statement count, index, statement kind discriminant, full Snapshot, ordered per-step effects, and aggregate CostReport without fabricating unresolved Step.value Some/None conventions, raw ExprId arena indices, per-prefix work fields on Step, or Core/2 continuation/target claims.

Declarative refusal expectations: oracle/refusal-expectations.json is consistent with static source semantics and meter charging rules (including eager boolean evaluation charging 5 units on unapproved reserve, late overdischarge rollback at statement 10 charging 35 units with code mori::core::liability, and cap-1 denials at the final Emit expression leaving used at 41 and 44 with unresolved resource error code left null), and is properly kept out of the positive test proposal.
limitations: Source-only and static oracle review: no shell, Cargo, rustc, parser, interpreter, compiler, prover, SDK, VM, or network execution was performed, and no runtime pass is claimed.

Exact ExprId arena indices, Step.statement inner expression IDs, Step.value Some/None ABI conventions, canonical program hashes, and metered resource refusal error codes remain unresolved in the oracle and untested by the positive test proposal.

Core/1 local simulation does not authenticate predecessor state, history, logical time, account ownership, or external budget bindings (such as the literal 57 reserve floor budget in conditional-reserve.mori), and Core/1 requires guards do not substitute for Core/2 durable await/continuation semantics or full U2 compiler/artifact/proof/target pipeline qualification.
refusal-expectations.json was reviewed only as a declarative source proposal and is not adopted or approved as an executable hostile/security test suite here.
